title: Reminder CRUD in the workspace
acceptance: Create, edit, complete and delete reminders through the existing API with validation and errors shown; axe passes
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 3 hours agent; former 2-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: 1.5 h/day judged rate (PR #277). Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 2 kept as history.
